    customers_list = instance["customer_ids"]
    demands = instance["demands"]

        return []

    def route_load(route):
        s = 0
        for v in route:
            s += demands[v]
        return s

        if not route:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][route[0]] + matrix[route[-1]][depot]
        for i in range(len(route) - 1):
            c += matrix[route[i]][route[i + 1]]
        return c

    def total_cost(routes):
        s = 0
        for r in routes:
            s += route_cost(r)
        return s

    # Each customer as its own route
    routes = [[v] for v in customers_list]
    route_loads = [demands[v] for v in customers_list]

    # Position maps: node -> (route_index, position_in_route)
    node_route = {}
    node_pos = {}
    for ri, r in enumerate(routes):
        for pi, v in enumerate(r):
            node_route[v] = ri
            node_pos[v] = pi

    # Compute savings for all ordered pairs (i, j), i!=j
    # Savings: d(depot,i)+d(depot,j)-d(i,j)
    savings = []
    for i in customers_list:
        for j in customers_list:
            if i == j:
                continue
            s = matrix[depot][i] + matrix[depot][j] - matrix[i][j]
            savings.append((s, i, j))
    savings.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], -x[1], -x[2]), reverse=True)

    merged = True
    while merged:
        merged = False
        for s, i, j in savings:
            if i not in customers_set or j not in customers_set:
                continue
            if i not in node_route or j not in node_route:
                continue
            ri = node_route[i]
            rj = node_route[j]
            if ri == rj:
                continue

            # We only merge when i is at an end of its route and j is at an end of its route,
            # and the connection orientation is consistent to produce a single route.
            li = node_pos[i]
            lj = node_pos[j]
            r1 = routes[ri]
            r2 = routes[rj]

            # Try merging: r1 ends with i, r2 starts with j -> r1 + r2
            can1 = (li == len(r1) - 1) and (lj == 0)
            # Try merging: r1 starts with i, r2 ends with j -> reverse both to connect ends: rev(r1)+rev(r2)
            can2 = (li == 0) and (lj == len(r2) - 1)
